title: The Reading One Line Aloud
youtube_title: The Reading One Line Aloud | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Ilaria feels shy about an one line that could be read aloud. Instead of pretending not to care, Ilaria tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
